product: Share Manager - Fast Media Sorter & Sharing

commands.name: commands
commands.summary: List the commands this program accepts.

args.name: json
args.description: print the manifest (docs/cli-commands.share-manager.json) instead of the readable list

exitCodes.meaning: printed
unknown option

examples.expect: exit 0 and the file equals docs/cli-commands.share-manager.json

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Print the version of this program.

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

returns.name: version
returns.description: the program version

returns.name: cliVersion
returns.description: the version of the command set this manifest describes

exitCodes.meaning: printed
unknown option

examples.expect: exit 0 and the version on the console

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Report whether the Share Manager is running and ready for commands.

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: version
returns.description: the running program's version

returns.name: pid
returns.description: its process id

returns.name: exe
returns.description: its file name

returns.name: ready
returns.description: true when no question or dialog blocks commands

returns.name: acceptsRestrictedCommands
returns.description: whether the setting admits commands of a class other than safe

returns.name: workerAvailable
returns.description: whether the sharing worker payload is installed

returns.name: sharing
returns.description: whether sharing is switched on now

exitCodes.meaning: running and ready
not running, or busy

examples.expect: 0 while the manager runs and is ready, 11 otherwise

commands.name: show
commands.summary: Bring the Share Manager window forward, starting the program when it is not running.

exitCodes.meaning: the window is forward
the running copy is older and must be restarted
busy: a question or a dialog is open in the running program

examples.expect: exit 0 and the window in front

commands.name: quit
commands.summary: Close the running Share Manager, as the tray menu Exit does.

exitCodes.meaning: closed, or was not running
busy: a question or a dialog is open in the running program

examples.expect: exit 0 and no Share Manager process is left

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Make sure the Share Manager is running and apply its startup option as a plain launch does; with --silent it shows no window and no hint, as the logon autostart does.

args.name: silent
args.description: show nothing: no window, no tray hint; the shipped --tray spelling means this

exitCodes.meaning: running
the running copy is older and must be restarted
busy: a question or a dialog is open in the running program

examples.expect: exit 0; the tray icon is up and no window is shown

commands.name: share add
commands.summary: Propose a folder to share; the person answers the proposal in the manager before anything is shared.

args.name: folder
args.description: a folder by drive letter or UNC path, no .. segment and no wildcard

returns.name: proposal
returns.description: queued, duplicate, already-shared or full: what became of the proposal

exitCodes.meaning: proposed (queued, duplicate or already shared)
not an acceptable folder spelling
thirty-two proposals are already waiting, or a question is open
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off

examples.expect: exit 0 and C:\temp\p.json holds the proposal verdict

commands.name: resource add
commands.summary: Open the guided flow that adds a resource, with the camera QR scan when --camera is given.

args.name: camera
args.description: start with the camera QR scan; the shipped add-resource-camera spellings mean this

exitCodes.meaning: the flow window is shown
busy: a question or a dialog is open in the running program

examples.expect: exit 0 and the camera scan on screen

commands.name: schedule open
commands.summary: Open the Scheduled file operations window; a folder pre-fills the source of a new operation that the person still has to save.

args.name: folder
args.description: the pre-filled source folder

exitCodes.meaning: the window is shown
not an acceptable folder spelling
busy: a question or a dialog is open in the running program

examples.expect: exit 0 and the window open with D:\Photos as the source

commands.name: broadcast open
commands.summary: Open the live broadcast window with a path preselected.

args.name: path
args.description: a drive or UNC path the window preselects

exitCodes.meaning: the window is shown
not an acceptable path spelling
busy: a question or a dialog is open in the running program

commands.name: clipboard send
commands.summary: Send the clipboard to the exchange server and say how it went.

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: outcome
returns.description: a closed token for the result line: sent, empty, no-account, busy, too-large, no-room, no-answer, cancelled or failed

returns.name: bytes
returns.description: size sent

exitCodes.meaning: sent
the operation failed or was cancelled
not proven: the running program may still be working
no exchange account, nothing to send, or another clipboard operation is under way
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off
the clipboard is larger than the server accepts, or the server has no room
the server did not answer

examples.expect: 0 when the clipboard reached the server

commands.name: clipboard get
commands.summary: Fetch the newest clipboard from the exchange server into the local clipboard and say how it went.

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: outcome
returns.description: a closed token for the result line: received, empty, no-account, busy, no-answer, cancelled or failed

returns.name: bytes
returns.description: size received

exitCodes.meaning: received
the operation failed or was cancelled
not proven: the running program may still be working
no exchange account, nothing on the server, or another clipboard operation is under way
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off
the server did not answer

examples.expect: 0 when the server clipboard is now the local one

commands.name: share list
commands.summary: List the folders the Share Manager shares and the state of each.

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: shares
returns.description: one object per shared folder: folder (the path), state (serving or stopped) and writable (true when the folder accepts uploads); no password, PIN, token or address of a peer

exitCodes.meaning: answered
the sharing worker did not answer
not running
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off

commands.name: schedule list
commands.summary: List the scheduled file operations with their next run and their last result; with no manager running the program reads the operations, answers and exits, starting no scheduler.

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: operations
returns.description: one object per scheduled operation: id (a GUID), name, action (copy, move, delete, archive, fill-free-space, backup or unknown), enabled (bool), nextRun (ISO 8601 with the offset, or null while the operation is off or parked) and lastResult (none, ok, failed, refused, wall, cancelled, skipped or unknown); for backup operations, also retention (generations, keep-days or keep-days+keep-monthly), keep (int, when generations) or keepDays (int, when dated), keepMonthly (bool) and skipLinks (bool); no folder, no file name, no error text

exitCodes.meaning: answered
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off

examples.line: Start-Process .\FastMediaSorterCompanion.exe -ArgumentList 'schedule list --result C:\temp\ops.json' -Wait; Get-Content C:\temp\ops.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
examples.expect: an object with an operations array

commands.name: exchange status
commands.summary: Say what the exchange client last knew about its server; no network call is made. With no manager running the program reads whether an account is set up, answers (state stopped, no request waiting) and exits.

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: accountConfigured
returns.description: whether an exchange account is set up on this PC

returns.name: state
returns.description: the last known state of the connection: not-configured, connecting, online, reconnecting, sign-in-again, pin-mismatch, update-needed, defect or stopped; no server address, user name or key

returns.name: pendingRequests
returns.description: how many requests of other programs to share a folder wait for the person's answer in the manager

exitCodes.meaning: answered

examples.line: Start-Process .\FastMediaSorterCompanion.exe -ArgumentList 'exchange status --result C:\temp\ex.json' -Wait; Get-Content C:\temp\ex.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
examples.expect: an object with accountConfigured, state and pendingRequests

commands.name: schedule add
commands.summary: Create or update a scheduled backup operation without opening a window.

args.name: action
args.description: operation action (backup)

args.name: source
args.description: absolute drive or UNC source folder

args.name: destination
args.description: absolute drive or UNC destination folder outside the source

args.name: daily
args.description: daily run time in 24-hour HH:mm form (local wall clock)

args.name: keep
args.description: how many numbered generations to keep (1 to 999; cannot be combined with --keep-days)

args.name: keep-days
args.description: keep dated backups for N days (1 to 999); cannot be combined with --keep

args.name: keep-monthly
args.description: keep the earliest backup of each calendar month indefinitely (requires --keep-days)

args.name: skip-links
args.description: skip junctions and symbolic links instead of refusing the backup

args.name: name
args.description: display name for the operation

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: id
returns.description: operation id (GUID)

returns.name: created
returns.description: true when a new operation was created; false when an existing matching operation was updated

returns.name: nextRun
returns.description: next scheduled run (ISO 8601 with offset)

exitCodes.meaning: saved
invalid option, refused definition or FileDO without the needed backup support
busy: a question or a dialog is open in the running program
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off

examples.line: Start-Process .\FastMediaSorterCompanion.exe -ArgumentList 'schedule add --action backup --source P:\MyProject --destination C:\GD\GIT --daily 13:00 --keep-days 7 --keep-monthly --result C:\temp\add.json' -Wait -PassThru
examples.expect: exit 0 and C:\temp\add.json holds the operation id

commands.name: schedule remove
commands.summary: Delete a scheduled operation definition without touching any backup files.

args.name: target
args.description: operation id or exact operation name

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: id
returns.description: id of the removed operation

returns.name: removed
returns.description: true when the definition was deleted

exitCodes.meaning: removed
unknown option or ambiguous operation name
operation not found, or busy with an open window
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off

examples.expect: exit 0 and the operation definition is deleted while backup files remain

commands.name: schedule run
commands.summary: Queue one scheduled operation or all enabled operations for immediate execution on the single lane; with --wait, wait for completion and exit with its outcome.

args.name: target
args.description: operation id or exact operation name

args.name: all
args.description: queue every enabled operation not already in the lane

args.name: wait
args.description: wait for the queued run(s) to finish and return the run outcome

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: queued
returns.description: number of operations queued

returns.name: completed
returns.description: true when --wait waited until every queued run finished

returns.name: succeeded
returns.description: runs that ended ok (when --wait)

returns.name: failed
returns.description: runs that did not end ok (when --wait)

returns.name: outcome
returns.description: queued, or the run outcome token (ok, failed, refused, wall, cancelled, skipped)

exitCodes.meaning: queued, or every waited run finished ok
the waited run failed
not proven: the wait bound passed while the run may still be working
missing target/--all, unknown option or ambiguous operation name
operation not found, paused, nothing to run, already running, busy or target unreachable
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off
no space on the target disk
network or remote share failure
cancelled

examples.expect: 0 when every enabled operation finished without errors

commands.name: schedule history
commands.summary: Print the scheduled operations journal; with no manager running the program reads the journal, answers and exits.

args.name: operation
args.description: filter by operation id or exact name

args.name: last
args.description: maximum number of newest entries to return (1 to 500)

args.name: json
args.description: print the response line instead of a sentence

args.name: result
args.description: write the returned data to this file, whole

returns.name: entries
returns.description: newest-first journal objects: time (ISO 8601 with offset), operationId, operation, kind (run or note), trigger, outcome, files (int), failed (int), bytes (int64), durationMs (int64), generation (int or null), retiredGeneration (int or null), retiredCount (int or null), keptCount (int or null), keepDays (int or null), monthlyKept (int or null), skippedLinks (int or null) and detail

exitCodes.meaning: answered
reading failed or response exceeded 64 KiB (narrow with --last or use --result)
invalid --last value (must be 1 to 500)
the setting that lets other programs ask this app to work with files, screen, clipboard or the network is off

examples.line: Start-Process .\FastMediaSorterCompanion.exe -ArgumentList 'schedule history --last 20 --result C:\temp\hist.json' -Wait; Get-Content C:\temp\hist.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
examples.expect: an object with an entries array
